# Homedit

> > Homedit is a modern home design inspiration platform offering curated interior design trends, DIY guides, furniture ideas, and digital wall art for contemporary living.

Homedit combines editorial content on home design trends, kitchen and bathroom inspiration, and outdoor living with a curated shop featuring digital prints and framed wall art. The site is led by founder Stefan Gheorghe and features expert contributors covering interior design, home improvement, and construction.

## Key Topics

- 2026 Design Trends
- Interior Design

- DIY Home Projects

- [15 Furniture Ideas for 2026 Where Statement Pieces Replace Overfilled Rooms](https://www.homedit.com/statement-furniture-pieces-for-2026): 2026 furniture trends emphasizing statement pieces over maximalist design.
- [10 Outdated Patio and Backyard Trends Everyone Is Ready to Leave Behind in 2026](https://www.homedit.com/outdated-patio-and-backyard-trends-everyone-is-ready-to-leave-behind-in-2026): Analysis of outdated outdoor design trends and 2026 patio predictions.
- [8 Outdoor Flooring Ideas Designers Are Choosing Instead of Concrete Patios in 2026](https://www.homedit.com/outdoor-flooring-ideas-designers-are-choosing-instead-of-concrete-patios-in-2026): Alternative outdoor flooring options to concrete for 2026 patio design.
- [17 Outdated Interior Design Trends Everyone Is Ready to See Go in 2026](https://www.homedit.com/outdated-interior-design-trends-everyone-is-ready-to-see-go-in-2026): Analysis of outdated interior design trends and 2026 predictions.
- [10 Glass Room Divider Ideas for 2026 That Add Structure Without Adding Drywall](https://www.homedit.com/glass-room-divider-ideas-for-2026): Interior design guide on glass room dividers for open floor plans.
